name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion: a basic savings bank deposit account with no minimum balance for people who do not have a bank account.

criteria.label: You do not already have a bank account

evidence.quote: by persons not having any other account.

benefits.text: Basic savings bank account with no minimum balance, and interest on deposits.

evidence.quote: There is no requirement to maintain any minimum balance in PMJDY accounts.

benefits.text: RuPay debit card with accident insurance cover (Rs. 2 lakh for accounts opened after 28.8.2018).

evidence.quote: Accident Insurance Cover of Rs.1 lakh (enhanced to Rs. 2 lakh to new PMJDY accounts opened after 28.8.2018) is available with RuPay card issued to the PMJDY account holders.

benefits.text: Overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible account holders.

evidence.quote: An overdraft (OD) facility up to Rs. 10,000 to eligible account holders is available.

applicationProcess: Open the account at any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet.
